name: Send Telegram message
description: Sends a text message through one of the venue's bots. Takes the Telegram Bot API sendMessage parameters as-is (https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage): chat_id (numeric chat id — a person's private chat is their user id, groups are negative; the bot's /id command shows it — or @channelusername), text, and optionally parse_mode, entities, link_preview_options, disable_notification, protect_content, message_thread_id, reply_parameters ({message_id, ...}), reply_markup (inline keyboards) and any other sendMessage field. Returns the sent Message as Telegram describes it. Two conveniences: text over 4096 characters is split into consecutive messages, and if a parse_mode is set and Telegram rejects the formatting the text is resent plain. Requires telegram/send on <bot user>/telegram/<bot>: the bot's user (and their agents, within scope) may send; others need a delegation from that user.

bot.description: Bot name (adapters.telegram.bots key). Optional when the caller owns exactly one bot.

parse_mode.description: Formatting mode. Defaults to the bot's configured parseMode, else plain text.

output.description: The sent Telegram Message (the last one when the text was split): message_id, chat, date, text, ...
